title: First, Last, and Linear Touch Attribution
description:
Converted customers have one or more marketing touches. Credit each channel three ways: **first-touch** (1 if first event), **last-touch** (1 if last event), and **linear** (`1 / touch_count` per touch). Sum credits by channel.

**Tables:** `touches` (`customer_id`, `channel`, `touched_at`), `conversions` (`customer_id`)

Output columns: `channel`, `first_touch_credit`, `last_touch_credit`, `linear_credit`. Order by `channel`. Round linear credit to 2 decimals.
schema_sql: CREATE TABLE touches (customer_id INT, channel VARCHAR, touched_at TIMESTAMP); INSERT INTO touches VALUES (1,'google','2026-01-01 10:00:00'),(1,'email','2026-01-02 10:00:00'),(1,'direct','2026-01-03 10:00:00'),(2,'facebook','2026-01-01 11:00:00'),(2,'google','2026-01-04 11:00:00'); CREATE TABLE conversions (customer_id INT); INSERT INTO conversions VALUES (1),(2);
solution_sql: WITH ranked AS (SELECT t.channel, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t.customer_id ORDER BY t.touched_at) AS rn_first, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t.customer_id ORDER BY t.touched_at DESC) AS rn_last, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY t.customer_id) AS n FROM touches t WHERE t.customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM conversions)) SELECT channel, SUM(CASE WHEN rn_first = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS first_touch_credit, SUM(CASE WHEN rn_last = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS last_touch_credit, ROUND(SUM(1.0 / n), 2) AS linear_credit FROM ranked GROUP BY channel ORDER BY channel
hints: ROW_NUMBER ASC and DESC on touched_at mark first and last touches.
COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id) is the denominator for linear credit.
explanation: Customer 1: google → email → direct (linear 1/3 each). Customer 2: facebook → google (linear 1/2 each). First-touch totals: google 1, facebook 1. Last-touch: direct 1, google 1. Linear google = 0.33+0.50 = 0.83.
